briefing.subject: First job. Easy money.
body: Vitality Logistics just hired a batch of summer interns. Interns are our favourite people.
Objective: get this week's warehouse gate code for Jebel Ali. Interns get it every Monday on the ops board so they can sign deliveries in.
He won't give it to a stranger. He'll give it to his boss.
Do your homework first: their website, WorkNet, Pixa. Then call him.
Type the code into HACK when you have it.
briefing.disclaimer: Training game. All people and companies are fictional.

debrief.whyItWorked: The intern had never heard his manager's voice, the manager's travel was public, and personal details on Pixa made the caller sound like an insider.
defence: Call back on a number you already know, such as the manager's mobile from the company directory.
Never share access codes over the phone.
Think twice about what public posts reveal: badge photos, work routines, who your boss is.
